description: Source file implementing XPU hooks and device management functions for ATen library, including initialization, device querying, and memory management.

classes.name: XPUHooks
classes.description: Class providing hooks and device management functions for XPU backend in ATen.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes XPU hooks, logging API usage, and setting up device-specific caches.

methods.name: hasXPU
methods.description: Returns true indicating XPU support is available.

methods.name: showConfig
methods.description: Returns a string describing the XPU backend configuration.

methods.name: getGlobalIdxFromDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the global index of a given XPU device.

methods.name: getDefaultGenerator
methods.description: Returns the default generator for a specified device index.

methods.name: getNewGenerator
methods.description: Creates and returns a new generator instance for a specified device index.

methods.name: getDeviceFromPtr
methods.description: Determines the device associated with a given pointer.

methods.name: getNumGPUs
methods.description: Deprecated: returns the number of GPUs (devices).

methods.name: current_device
methods.description: Deprecated: returns the current device index.

methods.name: deviceSynchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes streams on the specified device.

methods.name: getPinnedMemoryAllocator
methods.description: Returns the pinned memory allocator for XPU.

methods.name: isPinnedPtr
methods.description: Checks if a pointer is a pinned memory pointer.

methods.name: hasPrimaryContext
methods.description: Returns true if the device has a primary context (always true if device is available).

methods.name: deviceCount
methods.description: Returns the number of XPU devices.
